name: OmAiry
author: Tiedeyez
description: A small fairy of light that lives on your desktop, drawn as a 16-bit handheld style pixel sprite. It flaps on three frames inside a dithered, palette-cycling glow, moves in whole pixels, leaves a trail of twinkling pixel sparkles, visits whichever window you are working in and sometimes perches on top of it to rest. Click it and a ring of light pulses out and it speaks in a retro RPG text box that types itself out. Colours follow your theme's accent. Starts no processes, touches no files and makes no network requests; it hides under fullscreen windows and holds still when animations are turned off.
